name: Print and Play Games
bio: Print and Play Games (printandplay.games) publishes free historical and strategy board games for players to print and build themselves, including the grand strategy game Ultima Ratio Regis, the medieval Spain game Taifa, the space opera Nova and the economic game Ekonos. The site footer states that its games are published under Creative Commons licences; no specific licence is named on the game pages, so this site links to the downloads.
